explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/146 (the Erdős–Simonovits conjecture) and its OpenAI disproof. It negates: for every r ≥ 1 and every bipartite r-degenerate H (every nonempty vertex subset has a vertex with at most r neighbours inside it), ex(n;H) = O(n^{2-1/r}). The page's counterexample with r = 2 refutes the universal statement.
